LESSON: DOMESTIC VIOLENCE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Domestic violence
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Domestic violence, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the causes of domestic violence? 2. How does domestic violence hinder social harmony?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the causes of domestic violence to settle family conflicts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Domestic violence in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the effects of domestic violence on the family,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Domestic violence in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. describe measures to curb domestic violence in the family,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Domestic violence in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. embrace measures proposed by Islam to curb domestic violence.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Domestic violence in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. explain the causes of domestic violence to settle family conflicts,

   Domestic violence helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the effects of domestic violence on the family,

   Domestic violence helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. describe measures to curb domestic violence in the family,

   Domestic violence helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. embrace measures proposed by Islam to curb domestic violence.

   Domestic violence helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the causes of domestic violence in groups and present in class,

2. discuss the effects of domestic violence in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,

3. watch video clips/read about the effects of domestic violence and make notes,

4. research on the measures of curbing domestic violence and make notes,

5. prepare a skit condemning domestic violence. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the causes of domestic violence in groups and present in class,
2. discuss the effects of domestic violence in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,
3. watch video clips/read about the effects of domestic violence and make notes,
4. research on the measures of curbing domestic violence and make notes,
5. prepare a skit condemning domestic violence. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Domestic violence together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology through researching on the measures of curbing

domestic violence.

• Learning to Learn: the skill of carrying out research enhanced as learners research on the measures of curbing

domestic violence.

• Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the skill of explanation enhanced as learners research and explain the

measures of curbing domestic violence.

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners prepare a skit condemning domestic violence.

Values:
● Peace is enhanced through research on the measures of curbing domestic violence and making notes.

● Social Justice is enhanced through research on the measures of curbing domestic violence.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Social Cohesion is enhanced as learners research on the measures of curbing domestic violence.

● Gender education is enhanced as learners discuss the causes of domestic violence.

Link to other Subjects:

Social Studies as learners discuss the effects of domestic violence in groups.

Main points to remember:

1. explain the causes of domestic violence to settle family conflicts,
2. explain the effects of domestic violence on the family,
3. describe measures to curb domestic violence in the family,
4. embrace measures proposed by Islam to curb domestic violence.
